title: CheckID Registry
description: Schema for CheckID registry.json — a universal identifier registry mapping security checks across compliance frameworks. Source of truth: SCF (Secure Controls Framework).

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the registry schema format.

dataVersion.description: Date the registry data was generated (YYYY-MM-DD).

generatedFrom.description: Source files used to generate this registry.

checks.description: Array of check objects, each representing a security check mapped to one or more compliance frameworks.

name.description: Human-readable name of the security check.

collector.description: Data collector responsible for this check.

hasAutomatedCheck.description: Whether this check has an automated implementation.

minimum.description: Minimum license tier required. Use 'AzureSubscription' for Azure ARM checks.

scf.description: SCF (Secure Controls Framework) metadata — the authoritative source for this check's compliance identity.

frameworks.description: Map of framework identifiers to their mapping details.

severity.description: Impact severity if this check fails.

rationale.description: Brief explanation of the severity rating.

effort.description: Implementation effort metadata for remediation planning.

complexity.description: Implementation complexity (1 = single config toggle; 5 = multi-team, multi-phase project).

isPhased.description: Whether this check requires a staged rollout rather than a single implementation step.

phaseCount.description: Number of sequential implementation phases required. Always 1 when isPhased is false.

disruptionRisk.description: Whether implementing this check risks disrupting users, services, or administrators.

disruptionScope.description: Scope of potential disruption. Omitted when disruptionRisk is false.

overrideReason.description: Free-text rationale for why this check's effort estimate overrides the derived defaults. Preserved from the inline `effortOverride.rationale` annotation in the source file. Absent when no override exists.

remediation.description: Actionable guidance for resolving a failing check, broken into typed channels: powershell, portal, graph, cli. Free-text caveats go in notes. v3.0+: structured object (was a single string in v2.x).

impact.description: What an attacker or auditor observes when this check fails. Distinct from remediation (fix) and rationale (why it matters).

rationale.description: The security principle behind this control — why it exists, written for a practitioner audience.

references.description: Links to official documentation supporting this check.

tags.description: Functional/topical tags for search and filtering.

primaryControlId.description: Primary SCF control ID (e.g., IAC-06, END-04.1).

additionalControlIds.description: Additional SCF control IDs that this check maps to.

domain.description: SCF domain (e.g., Identification & Authentication, Endpoint Security).

relativeWeighting.description: SCF relative control weighting for prioritization (1=low, 10=high).

remediation.description: Structured remediation guidance. At least one of powershell/portal/graph/cli/notes must be present; null channels are omitted, not included as null. Pure-prose remediation lands in notes alone — acceptable for v3.0 launch but candidates for future enrichment.

notes.description: Free-text caveats, prose-only remediation, or anything the parser couldn't structurally classify.

controlId.description: Control identifier(s) within the framework, semicolon-separated if multiple.

title.description: Human-readable title of the mapped control(s).

source.description: Where this mapping came from. Absent means scf-derived (default). 'manual-override' means it was added in framework-overrides.json (or, post-v3.0, inlined on the check). 'cis-paraphrased' / 'eidsca-crosswalk' / 'stig-manual' identify other authored sources.

reason.description: Free-text explanation for why this mapping exists. Primarily used on 'manual-override' entries to capture tribal knowledge (e.g. 'SCF lacks PR.AA-05 coverage for sign-in frequency'). Absent on 'scf-derived' entries since the source is self-explanatory.

sectionNumber.description: Phase 1 of #347 — top-level section number from the framework's authoritative source (e.g. CIS M365 v6 Section #). Optional; only populated when the source crosswalk supplies it.

assessmentStatus.description: Phase 1 of #347 — the source benchmark's own classification of whether this recommendation is automation-verifiable. Distinct from CheckID's hasAutomatedCheck (which is OUR automation status); this is the upstream framework's stance.

defaultValue.description: Phase 1 of #347 — Microsoft's factory / out-of-the-box state for this control. Drives gap analysis: 'is the tenant deviating from the default in a secure direction.'

cisSafeguardsByVersion.description: Phase 1 of #347 — CIS Safeguards crosswalk grouped by version (v8 + v7) and Implementation Group tier.

references.description: Phase 1 of #347 — citation URLs (and optional titles) from the source benchmark's References column. Factual citation only; CheckID's own references[] at check-level is a separate authored field.

cisAuthored.description: Phase 2 of #347 — CIS-authored prose. Populated locally per consumer via tools/import-cis-prose.py from their own licensed CIS XLSX. ABSENT in the public CheckID registry (CIS SecureSuite member terms forbid public redistribution); present only when the consumer has run the importer against their licensed copy. See LICENSES/CIS-CONSUMER-SIDE.md.

cisAuthoredProse.description: CIS-authored prose columns from the v6 spreadsheet — Description, Rationale Statement, Impact Statement, Remediation Procedure, Audit Procedure, Additional Information. Each field is optional so partial imports are valid (e.g., consumer chooses to import only Audit Procedure for verifier UX). All fields are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 + CIS member-restricted; consumers are responsible for honoring those terms when their tooling consumes this data.

rationale.description: CIS Rationale Statement column (verbatim). Distinct from CheckID's check-level rationale — that is CheckID-authored content.

impact.description: CIS Impact Statement column (verbatim). Distinct from CheckID's check-level impact — that is CheckID-authored content.

remediation.description: CIS Remediation Procedure column (verbatim, prose form). Distinct from CheckID's structured remediation object — that is the channel-typed actionable guidance.

audit.description: CIS Audit Procedure column (verbatim). How CIS itself describes verification — distinct from CheckID's hasAutomatedCheck (our automation status).

additionalInfo.description: CIS Additional Information column (verbatim). Notes, caveats, Microsoft-version dependencies, etc.

applicableIGs.description: The Implementation Groups (IG1/IG2/IG3) at which this CIS recommendation applies. CIS Implementation Groups are additive: IG2 ⊇ IG1, IG3 ⊇ IG2.
